€1P. (धमति, ध्मात; Caus. ध्मापयति) 
__1 To blow, breathe out, exhale. 
__2 To blow (as a wind-instrument), produce sound by blowing; शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् [[

]]; 17. 7. 
__3 To blow a fire, excite fire by blowing, excite sparks; को धमेच्छान्तं च पावकम् [[Mb.]] 
__4 To manufacture by blowing. 
__5 To cast, blow, or throw away.

p. p. [ध्मा-क्त] 
__1 Blown (as a wind-instrument). ध्माता गिरेर्धातवः [[Bh.]] 
__2 Blown up or into, inflamed, blown, fanned, excited. 
__3 Inflated, puffed, puffed up.
a. Reduced to ashes, burnt to cinder.
